name: ModelSamplingDiscrete base table + zero terminal SNR
plain: The sigma table every discrete SD-style model carries. It comes from a β schedule and is the source for simple, normal, ddim_uniform and beta. The ModelSamplingDiscrete node also switches prediction type (eps, v, lcm, x0, img_to_img, img_to_img_flow) and can rescale the table to zero terminal SNR.
math:
linear default: β_t = (linspace(√start, √end, T))², start 0.00085, end 0.012, T=1000. ᾱ=∏(1−β). σ_t=√((1−ᾱ)/ᾱ).
zsnr: √ᾱ' = (√ᾱ−√ᾱ_T)·√ᾱ_0/(√ᾱ_0−√ᾱ_T), σ'=√((1−ᾱ')/ᾱ'), with ᾱ'_T fixed to 4.897e-8.
Other β shapes: cosine, squaredcos_cap_v2, sqrt_linear, sqrt in make_beta_schedule.
label: from code
surprise: With zsnr the terminal value is not infinite but the constant 4.8973451890853435e-08, giving a very large finite sigma (model_sampling.py:21).
